title: Pin ci.yml's named packages: fail the local gate when a workflow step names a package that does not exist
body: Five integrated gates stayed green while .github/workflows/ci.yml named the deleted ./internal/herd/collect package, because the gate runs `go test -short ./...`, which only compiles what exists — a gap sx5's own note says outlives this epic. A small Go test that parses the workflow's `go test` steps and asserts every ./pkg/... they name still exists would have failed the FIRST gate after tick nkf's merge, and costs one file.
